modelOverview: Unveiled at the end of 2011 ahead of SIHH 2012, the RM 037 was the first watch to carry a fully in-house Richard Mille movement, the Calibre CRMA1. It pairs a skeletonised automatic with an oversize date at 12 o'clock and a pusher-operated function selector, and has since become one of the brand's longest-running references across titanium, gold, ceramic and Carbon TPT cases.

RM 037.movement: Automatic · Richard Mille Calibre CRMA1 · skeletonised, variable-geometry rotor · oversize date · function selector · 28,800vph · ~50h power reserve
RM 037.materials: Available in grade 5 titanium, 18k red gold, 18k white gold, Carbon TPT and ceramic case constructions
RM 037.dial: Skeletonised dial exposing the CRMA1 movement, with oversize date at 12 o'clock and a function-selector window at 4 o'clock showing winding, neutral and hand-setting modes
RM 037.description: The RM 037 Automatic Winding introduced the Calibre CRMA1, Richard Mille's first movement designed and built in-house, with an oversize date and a push-button function selector that moves between winding, neutral and hand-setting. Its tonneau case has been produced in titanium, red and white gold, ceramic and Carbon TPT, including gem-set versions. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Automatic Winding: The core RM 037 execution — tonneau case with skeletonised Calibre CRMA1 automatic movement, variable-geometry rotor, oversize date at 12 o'clock and pusher-operated function selector, offered across titanium, gold, ceramic and Carbon TPT cases.
